notes: Identified by Eaton (1865, vol. II pp.146–147) as a Fox Islands-born carpenter at Rockland's North End, married to Sarah Alexander, and nephew of Capt. Matthew Beverage. A later compiled genealogy gives born 20 Oct 1803 and names John White Beverage/Rachel Crosby as parents; those exact dates/parentage are deliberately NOT entered. Do not confuse with Nathaniel Winslow Beverage born 1776. The uncle/nephew degree conflicts with the proposal that Capt. Matthew was brother of Capt. Thomas and would need an original kinship record.
evidence_status: Near-contemporary 1865 family group, supplemented by compiled 1803/1838 lead. Parents and exact relationship to Matthew unproved.
